name: Boing

source.concept: Tin-can robot riding a coil spring; one visor eye; hops in place and forward.

behavior_contract: hops on a fixed rhythm, drifting forward
stomp from above: defeated, player bounces
side contact: player restarts at checkpoint
frozen at its placed spot outside runs; resets to its placed spot each attempt
immune to normal damage (only course rules defeat it)
skin_slot: cc_boing.png (64x64 box-UV layout; hi-res multiples of the same layout allowed)
